field_principles.accepted_rejected_n: Counts of accepted and rejected traces trained on; V-STaR's value is using BOTH (rejected traces define the boundary).
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A trained selector (even one that ties vote) is a COMPLETE verdict.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism is the precondition for reproducibility; the selector must be re-trainable to the same result.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content hash of the trace corpus + features; catches silent corpus drift between this run and any replication.
field_principles.selector_auroc_oof: Out-of-fold gold-vs-non-gold AUROC; the learned selector's discrimination, measured without oracle leakage.
field_principles.selector_pass1_vs_vote: pass@1 as a ranker minus SC-vote pass@1 (OOF) -- the learned-selector's standalone lift, input to A3.
